description:
Dainsleif , sometimes shortened to Dain , is an upcoming playable character in Genshin Impact . He is the featured character for Chapter ?? of the Teyvat Chapter Storyline , which focuses on the lost kingdom of Khaenri'ah , as well as the narrator of the Collected Miscellany videos. He makes his first in-game appearance in the World Quest Bough Keeper: Dainsleif in Chapter I : Act IV - Prelude.

Dainsleif is the former knight captain of the Royal Guard of Khaenri'ah . However, he failed to prevent the destruction of Khaenri'ah 500 years ago. A curse of immortality was placed upon him so that he would forever wander Teyvat .

Dainsleif was announced to be an upcoming playable character on September 27, 2020, in the stream celebrating the global release of Genshin Impact , although he is not expected to be released for a significant amount of time. The listed name of his Vision's element, as announced on his Chinese Character Card, is a set of indecipherable symbols ( ).
